cadence_basis.confidence: Strong renderer-geometry inference; the exact physical source-63 clock path remains to be confirmed from hardware or a definitive clock register.

implementation: A dedicated virtual audio timer requests one backpressured source-63 service every 666667 ns. Type-8 control traffic remains on its independent 10 ms timer.
decision: The emulator can sustain the candidate 32-frame / 48 kHz cadence in virtual time while producing nonzero host PCM and accepting later UI input. Keep the clock opt-in until its physical provenance is confirmed.
